player_prompt.intro:
A nyi azɔ Player {player_id} to aɖeɖe GameOfPureStrategy tɔn.
- A kpo 13 ami A-K; ɖeka ɖeka azɔ na wɛ gbɛte.
- Ɖeka ɖeka azɔ aɖeɖe a ɖoɖo ami na wɛ xɔ. Ɖoɖo kpo ami ɖeka pɛpɛpɛ kpo aɖeɖe a bracketed token tɔn tɛn '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Ami kpo ɖoɖo wɛ ɖoɖo (plus carry-over). Ɖeka ɖeka azɔ a tie wɛ ɖoɖo na pot tɔn a ɖoɖo azɔ.
- Ɖeka ɖeka azɔ a kpo ɖoɖo wɛ 13 azɔ wɛ.
